overall_recommendation.why_four_not_three: G1 and G2 establish the measurement object and why an individual repetition reference is needed; G3 shows validation logic; G4 shows unique anatomical interpretability. Merging any two overloads a slide or loses a distinct idea.
overall_recommendation.weakest_original_concept: G3 single-participant 671 funnel and/or locked 68→36→22→4 funnel implying only final-4 links matter
overall_recommendation.t3_represented_adequately: Partially: full T1→T3 data exported; main G4 uses D12 maps + D13 badges because coverage is limited for 252/651/671.
overall_recommendation.g3_defensible_without_cherry_picking: Yes if validation-layers with per-participant counts; no if 671-only funnel.
overall_recommendation.anatomical_map_honest: Yes at body-link/region resolution with verified poses; no continuous surface mesh available; requires_visual_mapping=true.
remaining_blockers: Confirm ≈4 / ≈10 class presentation wording against study protocol
Visualization agent must map links/regions onto avatar without inventing continuous surface precision
Do not use avatar_verified provenance_manifest denominators

funnel_misinterpretation_risks: Implies only final 4 links are meaningful (false: A2=22 is primary beyond-NV validated set)
Looks like a group-level filter (false: within-person analyses)
Collapses distinct statistical footings into one significance funnel

sum_convenience_only.warning: Sum across participants is a packaging convenience only; not a group-level result.

g2_progression_checks.recommended_annotation_policy: Prefer one primary annotation (usually endpoint Whole body vs Hands) and optionally a secondary note for fitted slope if both are 12/12; never treat them as interchangeable without stating both.

graphs.working_title: From progressive movement exploration to interpretable whole-body coordination
graphs.one_sentence_message: A cumulative progressive movement sequence is analyzed as one pooled whole-body block and converted into anatomically interpretable body-link contributions across Baseline, ≈4-class, and ≈10-class assessments within a broader blinded PhD design.
graphs.why_it_belongs: Committee needs the paradigm and pooled definition before any result.
graphs.why_it_might_not_belong: Could become a method poster if overloaded with preprocessing.
graphs.data_completeness: Complete for schematic; class counts flagged for protocol confirmation
graphs.risk_of_misinterpretation: Mistaking five stages for five independent analyses; mistaking study-context intervention mark for a treatment-effect claim
graphs.recommended_visualization: Left: cumulative body avatars Hands→Whole body. Center: bracket into ONE POOLED PROGRESSIVE MOVEMENT SEQUENCE. Right: JcvPCA concept to body-link contribution overlay. Secondary bottom: study-context timeline including blinded psilocybin/active-placebo intervention relative to Gaga classes and assessments.
graphs.alternative_visualization: Compact vertical flow if horizontal space limited
annotations: Each stage retains previous body involvement
graphs.caption_draft: The progressive guided sequence is analyzed as one pooled movement block. Body-link contributions are compared longitudinally at Baseline, after ≈4 Gaga classes, and after ≈10 Gaga classes within a broader blinded interventional design.

graphs.working_title: Natural repetition variability across progressive body involvement
graphs.scientific_question: Does the measurement respond sensibly to the movement paradigm?
graphs.one_sentence_message: Within-session repetition variability increases across the progressive sequence when expressed relative to each session average.
graphs.why_it_belongs: Motivates individual repetition-based reference without claiming treatment effects.
graphs.why_it_might_not_belong: Layer-2 descriptive only; order/fatigue confound; not the A2 gate.
graphs.major_limitation: Sequence order fixed; cannot separate progressive body involvement from order/fatigue
graphs.risk_of_misinterpretation: Causal openness claim; conflating fitted slope with endpoint change; treating as A2 evidence
graphs.recommended_visualization: Single plot; thin low-opacity trajectories per session; median + IQR; x=Hands→Whole body; y=Within-session repetition variability (relative to session average)
graphs.alternative_visualization: Small multiples by timepoint if session clutter is high

exact_axis_labels.x: Progressive sequence stage (Hands → + Elbows → + Shoulders → + Head → Whole body)
exact_axis_labels.y: Within-session repetition variability (relative to session average)

annotations: Endpoint check: 12/12 sessions Whole body > Hands (normalized)
Slope check: 12/12 sessions positive fitted progression slope
Do not conflate endpoint and slope in one phrase unless both are stated
graphs.caption_draft: Repetition-to-repetition variability changes systematically across the progressive sequence, motivating an individual repetition-based reference for longitudinal change. Descriptive protocol context only; order/fatigue cannot be separated from progressive body involvement.

graphs.working_title: Separating longitudinal change from natural repetition variability
graphs.scientific_question: How do we distinguish a potentially meaningful longitudinal change from ordinary improvisational variability or an unstable analytical result?
graphs.one_sentence_message: Validation layers show that many measured links remain within own repetition variability, while a participant-specific subset exceeds that variability and remains directionally stable; a still smaller subset meets a stricter interpretive-candidate stack.
graphs.why_it_belongs: Communicates methodological maturity without implying clinical significance testing.
graphs.why_it_might_not_belong: Can look like a group funnel or imply only S3 links matter if encoded poorly.
graphs.data_completeness: Full D12 and D13 evaluated links + exclusion rows
graphs.major_limitation: NV based on only two repetitions; S3 available only for 671 at D12
graphs.risk_of_misinterpretation: Funnel 68→36→22→4 implies only 4 meaningful links or a cohort result
graphs.recommended_visualization: VALIDATION LAYERS: four horizontal layers with per-participant counts — Measured links; Beyond repetition variability; Directionally stable (primary A2 layer); Interpretive candidate (optional S3). Explicit caption that A2 is the main validated beyond-NV layer and S3 is not the sole meaningful set. Optional four thin participant streams beneath.
graphs.alternative_visualization: BACKUP narrowing funnel using the same candidate counts, only if layers are visually unclear; must include anti-misread annotations.
graphs.missing_data_encoding: Show D13 as secondary/limited-coverage stream or badges; do not force symmetry
annotations: Within-person validation, not a group filter
A2 directionally stable exceeds are the primary beyond-NV claim
S3 interpretive candidates are stricter and currently limited
graphs.caption_draft: Longitudinal link differences are interpreted relative to each participant’s own within-session repetition variability and retained only when directionally stable under reference-orientation swap. Stricter interpretive-candidate criteria are shown separately and do not redefine the primary beyond-variability set.

illustrative_participant_671.why_strong_method_example: Best coverage + only S3 stack at D12 + rep_pass=True
illustrative_participant_671.why_not_sole_hero: Largest/richest effect would look cherry-picked; prefer all-participant layers

graphs.working_title: Preliminary anatomical patterns of movement reorganization
graphs.scientific_question: What can this framework reveal that a single movement score cannot?
graphs.one_sentence_message: It can localize preliminary longitudinal changes to specific body-link contributions within whole-body movement organization, with participant-specific patterns.
graphs.why_it_belongs: Unique interpretability advantage of JcvPCA; strongest admissions hero.
graphs.why_it_might_not_belong: Risk of looking like physiology/activation if encoded as continuous heatmap
graphs.data_completeness: D12+D13 rows exported; main visual recommended as D12 maps + D13 badges
graphs.major_limitation: Unequal denominators (651=10); limited D13 coverage; no verified continuous surface polygons
graphs.risk_of_misinterpretation: Continuous body-surface precision; warm=better; excluded=no effect; shared trajectory
graphs.recommended_visualization: Anatomical contribution map: four identical-pose scientific human avatars; neutral body; translucent link/region overlays only for validated A2 changes; hatch/outline for unavailable/excluded; D13 A2 k/n + coverage badges under each body. Not a continuous surface heatmap.
graphs.alternative_visualization: Link glyphs connected on simplified body if avatar overlay too ambiguous
